# Jubilees Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham's Instructions on Sacrifice and Purity

---

**21:1** And in the sixth year of the seventh week of this forty-second jubilee, Abraham called his son Isaac and commanded him, saying:

**21:2** "I am old and do not know the day of my death, and I am full of my days. Behold, I am one hundred and seventy-five years old.

**21:3** And throughout all the days of my life I have remembered the LORD and sought with all my heart to do his will and walk uprightly in all his ways. I have hated idols, and those who serve them I have rejected. And I have given my heart and my spirit that I should diligently observe what he wills.

**21:4** And my soul has hated idols, and I have despised those who serve them, and I have given my heart to love the LORD God.

**21:5** And do you also, my son, observe his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, and do not walk after abominations and after graven-images and after molten-images.

**21:6** And do not eat any blood of beasts or of birds during all the days of your life, and do not eat any fat of beasts, for the blood is the life, and the fat is the glory.

**21:7** And you shall not eat any blood; offer it upon the altar, and you shall offer upon the altar every fat of the beast, and every first-born male which is born of your cattle and of your flock you shall consecrate to the LORD your God.

**21:8** And every firstling which is born in your cattle and in your flock, you shall consecrate to the LORD your God, and you shall eat it in the sanctuary of the LORD your God at the place where the LORD your God shall choose.

**21:9** And all the tithe of cattle and of sheep — whatever enters under the rod — the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

**21:10** And do you offer upon the altar the fat thereof and the blood. And the flesh thereof shall be eaten in the holy place.

**21:11** And every offering which you offer on the altar, the fire shall consume it; do not leave any of it until the morning. And the altar you shall build of stones, and not of stones hewn with iron, and not of hewed stone shall you build it.

**21:12** And offer upon it a whole burnt-offering morning and evening, and a food-offering and an incense-offering, and frankincense in the morning, and in the evening offer incense and spices, sweet perfumes, and peace-offerings.

**21:13** And all the fat of the peace-offerings offer on the altar, but the fat that is upon the bowels and the liver and the kidneys, all this fat and these two kidneys, and all the fat that is upon them and upon the flanks and the diaphragm, you shall remove.

**21:14** And offer all this upon the altar of burnt-offering. It shall be a fire-offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD. And all your peace-offerings offer for the LORD God your God in truth.

**21:15** And you shall salt with salt every offering and shall not let the covenant of salt fail from all your offerings before the LORD.

**21:16** And as regards the wood of the burnt-offerings, be careful to bring only the following kinds: cypress, and pine, and almond, and fir, and cedar, and juniper, and fig and olive and myrtle and laurel and aspalathus and balsam.

**21:17** These kinds of wood offer under the burnt-offering on the altar. After you have tested each of them, do not offer any other wood under it; for the smell of each of these is sweet-smelling before the LORD.

**21:18** Of all the trees that exist in the world, these fourteen kinds of trees are those you shall offer on the altar under the burnt-offering.

**21:19** Guard yourself and your soul from all the blood, for I will demand the blood of all the souls out of the hand of man; from the hand of the beast I will demand it.

**21:20** And for all blood that is shed on the earth before the LORD, the earth is not purified from blood except by the blood of him who shed it.

**21:21** And do not take bribes for the blood of man, lest it be shed without judgment; for it is the blood of man that is shed, and those who shed the blood of man shall fall into the hand of the righteous judgment of the LORD.

**21:22** And you, my son, wash your hands and your feet before you approach the altar, and when you have washed them, do not leave blood on your hands or your feet.

**21:23** And you shall offer your burnt-offering and your peace-offerings. And the fire on the altar shall not be extinguished; it shall continually burn. And you shall offer every morning and every evening your offering upon the altar, and you shall offer incense upon the altar.

**21:24** And Isaac said to his father: "All these things I will observe, as you have commanded me. But I am afraid, my father, lest you should be angry with me if I ask you something."

**21:25** And Abraham said to him: "Ask what you will, and I will tell you." And Isaac said: "When you die, how shall I offer the burnt-offerings and the sacrifices after you? For I do not know how to offer them."

**21:26** And Abraham said to his son Isaac: "I have already written and left for you all the law and all the statutes and all the judgments which I received from the LORD on Mount Sinai from the angel of the presence, and all that is written in the book of the first law."

---
*EMET notes: The list of permitted altar-woods (vv.16-18) appears in Jubilees alone. "Salt of the covenant" (v.15) echoes Lev 2:13. Abraham's claim to have received the law on Sinai (v.26) is Jubilees' anachronistic retrojection of Mosaic law onto the patriarchs.*
